Scrape single page with WARC output enabled writes to file

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.crawl("{\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"warc_output\":\"/tmp/crawlberg_test.warc\"}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
